title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs: Cutting Administrative Requirements for Excellence in Patient Care
pass_4_primary_concern: CMS would remove comparable oversight information before validated replacement coverage and methods are demonstrated.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: Maternal emergencies, infection surveillance, nursing-home residents and facility fire/power safety involve vulnerable patients and potential serious injury.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal has a concrete burden-reduction rationale and retains substantial safeguards. The clearest structural concerns are loss of comparable oversight information before replacement methods are validated, and future safety-code substitutions through guidance without a fully defined public review process.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: Reduced outbreak visibility or payment transparency could persist before replacement measures are ready; optional code substitutions could take effect before affected parties can assess their technical basis.
